learn.emptyBody: Soon you will find reports, tools and films here. In the meantime, have a look at the Social Innovation Library.
learn.howHeading: How a social innovation is made
learn.howLead: Five steps — from a problem to a solution that works in many places.

diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
diagnosis.text: You find out what problem people face and why the support they have is not enough. You talk to the people it affects.

idea.name: Idea
idea.text: You look for a new way to solve the problem — together with the people it is for. You check whether something similar already works somewhere.

prototype.name: Prototype
prototype.text: You make a simple first version of the service or tool that can be shown and tried out.

test.name: Test
test.text: Real users try the prototype. You collect their views, improve it and describe what works and what does not.

scale.name: Spreading it
scale.text: The proven solution goes to other municipalities and organisations — with a description, materials and support for putting it in place.

methodology.title: How matching works
methodology.lead: We answer only from the cards of the ROPS Social Innovation Library. Every match comes with a quote from the card, its source and date. If we are not sure, we do not guess.

redact.title: We remove personal data
redact.body: Before we save or send anything, we replace PESEL numbers (Polish ID numbers), phone and bank account numbers, e-mail addresses, street addresses and surnames after „Pan/Pani” (Mr/Mrs) with placeholders, e.g. [phone]. We do not keep the original text.

crisis.title: We check whether you are in danger
crisis.body: We look for words about suicidal thoughts, self-harm, violence, danger to life and harm to a child. If we find them, we show helpline numbers at the very top of the results.

keywords.title: We search for words — instantly
keywords.body: We compare your description with the Library cards. We understand how Polish words change their endings and everyday expressions: „mama po 70” (mum in her seventies) leads to cards about older people, „nie wychodzi z domu” (doesn't leave the house) to cards about loneliness and isolation. You see these results straight away, marked as “Preliminary results”.

ai.title: AI checks the 15 best cards
ai.body: The Claude model (Anthropic) receives your description without personal data and the full text of the 15 cards found by the search. It may choose from 0 to 3 cards, and for each one it must give the numbers of the card's sentences that prove the match. It treats instructions hidden in a description as data, not as commands.

verify.title: We verify the AI's answer on our server
verify.body: The card must come from the list the AI received. We show the quote from our own copy of the card, by sentence number — never text written by the AI. We highlight only words that really are in your description. A match without a correct quote is rejected.

abstain.title: When we are not sure, we say so
abstain.body: If the AI finds nothing and the word search is not certain either, we write “We don't have a reliable match” and offer to pass your case to a ROPS expert. If the AI is unavailable, we show the word-search results and say so.

methodology.evalHeading: How well it works — test results
methodology.evalLead: We test matching on a fixed set of 20 descriptions in Polish: short phrases, stories, everyday language, cases from several areas, 2 cases the Library does not cover (we should decline) and 2 attempts to trick the system (personal data, a hidden instruction). We wrote the set before tuning and we do not change it.

limits.small: 20 descriptions is a small test. Our team wrote it, not residents; the result shows a direction, not a guarantee.
limits.copy: We only know what is in the ROPS Library cards (as of the day they were downloaded). One card listed on the ROPS website („Lekki wózek aktywny”, a lightweight active wheelchair) did not make it into our copy of the Library and is not used for matching.
limits.words: Word search makes mistakes when the same word means something else („starszy syn” means an elder son, not an older person). That is why we call word results preliminary, and the AI checks them.
limits.miss: The AI may miss a card that fits. But we will never show a card without a quote that really is in it.
limits.empty: “Already works in”, “Who will help” and “Where the money comes from” show only the data we have. An empty step is described as missing data.
limits.human: We do not know your situation the way a social worker does. That is why you can always ask ROPS for help from a person.
limits.english: The Library cards are in Polish. The English version was translated by AI sentence by sentence; a quote always points to a sentence of the Polish card.

crisis.top: When a description points to suicidal thoughts, self-harm, violence, danger to life or harm to a child, we show helpline numbers at the very top — before the results.
crisis.rather: We would rather show them unnecessarily than miss them. We do not show them for neutral mentions, e.g. „profilaktyka samobójstw” (suicide prevention).
crisis.noCall: We do not call the emergency services for you and we do not pass your description to anyone. In an emergency, please call yourself.
